name: everythingclaude
description: Speckit ERP - Monorepo with Frontend and Backend

scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n portal,console,api -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace @sap/web-portal" "npm run dev --workspace @sap/web-console" "npm run start:dev --workspace @sap/api"
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace @sap/api && npm run build --workspace @sap/web-portal && npm run build --workspace @sap/web-console
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @sap/web-portal && npm run build --workspace @sap/web-console
scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace @sap/shared-core && npm run build --workspace @sap/shared-schemas && npm run build --workspace shared-schemas && npm run build --workspace @speckit/wasm-modules && npm run build --workspace @sap/release-kernel && npm run build --workspace @sap/agent-kernel && npm run build --workspace @sap/platform-core && npm run build --workspace @sap/platform-release && npm run build --workspace @sap/agent-tools && npm run build --workspace @sap/domain-shipping
